name: adv_about_mcp_tools
description: Discover Zebrunner MCP capabilities — tools, prompts, resources, routing diff, and session metrics (format/detail breakdown, optional metrics_reset). Per-call timing via include_call_metrics on any tool.

name: adv_aggregate_test_cases_by_feature
description: Find ALL test cases related to a specific feature across the project. Searches title, description, preconditions, and test steps (case-insensitive). Groups by Root Suite and Feature Suite. Outputs: detailed (full hierarchy), short (summary), dto (JSON), test_run_rules (automation tags)

name: adv_analyze_regression_runtime
description: Analyze Regression Runtime Efficiency: per-launch elapsed time, attempt/re-run breakdown, per-test duration classification (Short/Medium/Long), Average Runtime per Test, Average Runtime per Test Case, Weighted Runtime Index, and optional baseline comparison with delta tracking

name: adv_analyze_screenshot
description: Visual analysis of screenshots with OCR, UI element detection, and AI vision analysis

name: adv_analyze_test_cases_duplicates
description: Find duplicate test cases using text similarity

name: adv_analyze_test_cases_duplicates_semantic
description: Find duplicate test cases using semantic/AI analysis

name: adv_analyze_test_execution_video
description: Download and analyze test execution video with AI vision - extracts frames and compares with test steps

name: adv_analyze_test_failure
description: Deep forensic analysis of failed tests including logs, screenshots, error classification, and comparison with last passed execution

name: adv_batch_get_test_cases
description: Fetch multiple test cases by key in one call (partial success). Use detail=summary and format=compact for token-efficient shortlists.

name: adv_create_test_case
description: (Beta) Create a new Test Case with runtime validation of priorities, automation states, and custom fields. Accepts { file_path } in attachments for local file upload. Optional source_case_key to pre-populate from an existing test case. Requires preview approval.

name: adv_create_test_suite
description: (Beta) Create a new Test Suite in a Zebrunner project. Requires preview approval before execution.

name: adv_detailed_analyze_launch_failures
description: Analyze ALL failures in a launch with intelligent grouping, executive summary, timeline analysis, and pattern detection

name: adv_download_test_screenshot
description: Download protected screenshots from Zebrunner with authentication

name: adv_find_flaky_tests
description: Find flaky tests across launches using a 3-phase approach: cross-launch flip-flop analysis, manual test case scan via TCM execution history, and dual-perspective enrichment of top flaky tests with TCM data

name: adv_generate_draft_test_by_key
description: Generate draft test code from test case specification

name: adv_generate_report
description: Universal report generator supporting 6 report types: quality_dashboard (HTML+Markdown with 6 panels), coverage (per-suite test coverage table), pass_rate (per-platform with targets), runtime_efficiency (with delta vs previous milestone), executive_dashboard (standup-ready combined report), release_readiness (Go/No-Go assessment). Can generate single or multiple reports per call.

name: adv_generate_weekly_regression_stability_report
description: Generate weekly regression stability report with pass rates, WoW delta, and Jira-ready output

name: adv_get_all_launches_for_project
description: List individual launch executions for a project with pagination. Use to browse launches, NOT for aggregated results/pass rates.

name: adv_get_all_launches_with_filter
description: Search and filter individual launch executions by milestone, build number, or name. NOT for aggregated results/pass rates.

name: adv_get_all_subsuites
description: Get all subsuites under a parent suite

name: adv_get_all_tcm_test_case_suites_by_project
description: Get all TCM test case suites by project with pagination

name: adv_get_all_tcm_test_cases_by_project
description: Get all test cases for a project. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries (steps, preconditions, automation state, deprecation events).

name: adv_get_all_tcm_test_cases_with_root_suite_id
description: Get all test cases for a project, enriched with rootSuiteId per case (hierarchy). Not the same as adv_get_all_tcm_test_cases_by_project.

name: adv_get_automation_priorities
description: Get available automation priorities

name: adv_get_automation_states
description: Get available automation states for test cases

name: adv_get_available_projects
description: Discover available Zebrunner projects

name: adv_get_bug_failure_info
description: Get failure information for a specific bug

name: adv_get_bug_review
description: Get detailed bug review information

name: adv_get_enhanced_test_coverage_with_rules
description: Enhanced test coverage analysis with rules engine

name: adv_get_launch_details
description: Get comprehensive information about a specific launch including test results, environment, and metadata

name: adv_get_launch_summary
description: Quick launch overview with key metrics and status

name: adv_get_launch_test_summary
description: Lightweight aggregated test results with statistics and most unstable tests

name: adv_get_platform_results_by_period
description: Get aggregated test results, pass rate, and statistics for a project over a time period (last 7 days, last 30 days, etc.). Returns total passed/failed/skipped/aborted counts and pass rate percentage. Use this when asked for 'results', 'pass rate', 'test statistics', or 'results for last N days'. Accepts any Zebrunner project key (e.g. 'DEF', 'MCP') or aliases (web/android/ios/api).

name: adv_get_project_milestones
description: Get milestones for a project

name: adv_get_root_id_by_suite_id
description: Find the root suite ID for any suite

name: adv_get_root_suites
description: Get root-level test suites

name: adv_get_suite_hierarchy
description: Get complete suite hierarchy tree

name: adv_get_tcm_suite_by_id
description: Get test suite by its numeric ID. Use for any 'show me suite', 'get suite by ID', 'find suite' request. Supports simple (fast direct API) and full (hierarchy-enriched) modes.

name: adv_get_tcm_test_suites_by_project
description: Get all test suites for a project

name: adv_get_test_case_distribution_by_field
description: Pie-chart distribution of test cases by TCM field (dashboard widget 37780)

name: adv_get_test_case_by_filter
description: Filter test cases by various criteria. Supports field_path/field_value/field_match for generic field-path filtering including custom fields. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries.

name: adv_get_test_case_by_key
description: Get detailed information for a specific test case by its key (e.g., MCP-123). Default format is 'json' — recommended when using as data source for adv_create_test_case or adv_update_test_case. Supports optional include_history to enrich with change log entries (steps, preconditions, automation state, deprecation events).

name: adv_get_test_case_by_title
description: Search for test cases by title. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries.

name: adv_get_test_cases_advanced
description: Advanced test case search with multiple filters. Supports field_path/field_value/field_match for generic field-path filtering including custom fields. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries.

name: adv_get_test_cases_by_automation_state
description: Get test cases filtered by automation state. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries.

name: adv_get_test_cases_by_suite_smart
description: Smart test case retrieval by suite ID with automatic root/child suite detection. Supports optional include_history to enrich each case with change log entries.

name: adv_get_test_coverage_by_test_case_steps_by_key
description: Analyze test coverage by test case steps

name: adv_get_test_execution_history
description: Track test execution trends across multiple launches with pass/fail history and pass rate

name: adv_get_test_run_by_id
description: Get test run details by ID

name: adv_get_test_run_configuration_groups
description: Get configuration groups for a test run

name: adv_get_test_run_result_statuses
description: Get result statuses for a test run

name: adv_get_top_bugs
description: Get top bugs affecting test results

name: adv_import_launch_results_to_test_run
description: Import automation launch results into a TCM Test Run by bridging Reporting API launches to Public API test runs (Beta)

name: adv_rerun_launch_failures
description: Rerun failed/aborted tests for one or more automation launches via the Reporting API (Beta)

name: adv_start_launch
description: Trigger Zebrunner Build Now (Jenkins integration only, not Launch Launchers) via job parameters and job:build (Beta)

name: adv_improve_test_case
description: Get AI-powered suggestions to improve test case quality

name: adv_list_test_run_test_cases
description: List test cases in a test run

name: adv_list_test_runs
description: List test runs with pagination

name: adv_list_test_suites
description: List test suites with pagination

name: adv_manage_test_run
description: Create, update, or add test cases to a Zebrunner Test Run (Beta)

name: adv_regression_results_analyzer
description: Analyze regression test results for a milestone or build: test run overview, new/top bugs, bugs per suite, and slowest tests

name: adv_test_reporting_connection
description: Test the connection to Zebrunner reporting API

name: adv_update_test_case
description: (Beta) Partially update an existing Test Case by numeric ID or string key (PATCH). Accepts { file_path } in attachments for local file upload. Requires preview approval.

name: adv_update_test_suite
description: (Beta) Update an existing Test Suite (full PUT replacement). Requires preview approval before execution.

name: adv_validate_test_case
description: Validate test case quality against best practices
